en_title: Zach Cregger Was 'Frustrated' the Conversation Around Resident Evil 'Didn't Have Anything to Do With the Movie'
cn_title: 《生化危机》导演对影片讨论感到沮丧
subtitle: 焦点不在电影
opus_summary: 《生化危机》导演Zach Cregger表示，影片上映前的大量讨论与电影本身无关，让他感到沮丧。他仍为影片感到自豪，但可能避开改编现有IP的电影。

paragraphs.en: Horror filmmaker Zach Cregger has explained why he was "frustrated" that much of the conversation around his Resident Evil film "didn't have anything to do with the movie."
paragraphs.cn: 恐怖电影导演扎克·克雷格解释了为何围绕他执导的《生化危机》电影的讨论让他感到「沮丧」：其中很多话题「与电影本身毫无关系」。

paragraphs.en: The mind behind hits like Barbarian and Weapons touched on his feelings about the lead-up to the premiere of his latest project during an appearance on The Town with Matthew Belloni podcast. Anyone who paid a second of attention to the Resident Evil movie adaptation knows Cregger struggled to win fans over ahead of its release, and it's something that left him frustrated from a number of angles.
paragraphs.cn: Cregger曾执导《野蛮人》和《Weapons》等卖座影片。他在播客《The Town with Matthew Belloni》中谈到了自己对最新作品首映前那段时间的感受。稍微关注过《生化危机》电影改编的人都知道，Cregger在影片上映前很难赢得粉丝认可，这让他在多个方面都感到沮丧。

paragraphs.en: "I think I was frustrated at the conversation around Resident Evil and how much of the conversation really didn't have anything to do with the movie," he said when explaining why he will likely stray from making movies based on established IP in the future.
paragraphs.cn: 在解释自己今后为何可能避开改编现有IP的电影时，他说：「我想，让我感到沮丧的是围绕《生化危机》的讨论，其中很多内容实际上都与电影本身毫无关系。」

paragraphs.en: "It had everything to do with whether the movie was living up to the different standards that different fans of the games had. Whether it was using the characters or not, or what did I get wrong in the lore? It was just a lot about, 'Why isn't this like the source material, or why is it good that it's not like the source material? All the conversation just felt like it was about not the movie."
paragraphs.cn: 「讨论全都围绕着电影是否满足不同游戏粉丝的不同标准：有没有使用游戏角色？我把哪些背景设定弄错了？很多话题都在问：为什么它不像原作，或者它不像原作为什么是件好事？感觉所有讨论都没有聚焦电影本身。」

paragraphs.en: Skeptical viewers harped on most of the same topics between the release of Resident Evil's first trailer and its theatrical premiere. Where's Leon? Why is it snowing in Raccoon City? Why does Austin Abrams' character have a smartphone? This vocal group of fans spent most of their time worried about what the film meant for the games it was based on and less about how it might carve out its own place in Capcom's wider universe.
paragraphs.cn: 从《生化危机》首支预告片发布到影片院线上映，持怀疑态度的观众反复讨论的大多是同样的话题：里昂在哪儿？浣熊市为什么在下雪？Austin Abrams饰演的角色为什么有智能手机？这群积极发声的粉丝把大部分精力放在担忧电影会给改编所依据的游戏带来什么影响，而较少关注它可能如何在卡普空更广阔的世界中开辟自己的位置。

paragraphs.en: Although Cregger did his best to explain that he took creative liberties to improve the overall quality of the movie, he did little to calm the storm of those who have longed to see the faces and places they know and love on the big screen. He did eventually go on to admit he was naïve to assume there would be any other outcome, but uncertain fans remained uneasy about what the final product might look like all the way up until its September 18 release date.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管Cregger竭力解释自己为了提升电影的整体质量而在创作上作出了改动，但这并未平息那些渴望在大银幕上看到熟悉且喜爱的角色和场景的粉丝所掀起的风波。他最终承认，自己曾天真地以为事情会有不同的结果，但心存疑虑的粉丝直到影片9月18日上映，仍对最终成片感到不安。

paragraphs.en: So, how did it do? Despite the backlash, it was a tremendous hit, and it's one Cregger is proud of.
paragraphs.cn: 那么，影片的表现如何？尽管遭遇了反对声浪，它仍然大获成功，Cregger也为这部作品感到自豪。

paragraphs.en: The average movie fan who went to see Resident Evil was generally happy with a new, snowy vision of Raccoon City, too. The film premiered to great reviews (IGN gave it an 8/10 ) and opened to a whopping $108 million at the worldwide box office.
paragraphs.cn: 走进影院观看《生化危机》的普通影迷，普遍也对这个被白雪覆盖的全新浣熊市感到满意。影片上映后收获了出色的评价（IGN为其打出8分，满分10分），全球首映票房高达1.08亿美元(约合人民币7亿元)（人民币换算所需汇率未提供）。

paragraphs.en: With a reported budget of $75 million, that was already a solid start, but audiences also continued to show up for the movie in the weeks that followed. Now, as the Halloween weekend draws to a close, Resident Evil has managed to cross $400 million across the globe. That's probably enough success to convince Sony to bring Cregger back for a sequel, but it may be best to keep expectations on that front low for now.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，影片预算为7500万美元(约合人民币5亿元)（人民币换算所需汇率未提供），因此这个成绩已经算是一个不错的开局。此后数周，观众也持续走进影院观看这部电影。如今，随着万圣节周末接近尾声，《生化危机》的全球票房已突破4亿美元(约合人民币27亿元)（人民币换算所需汇率未提供）。这样的成绩或许足以说服索尼请回Cregger执导续集，但目前最好还是降低对这方面的期待。

paragraphs.en: "I'm proud of the movie. I really love the movie," Cregger elaborated during the podcast appearance. "I realize I should have known better going into it. I should have understood that was going to be the case, but for some reason, I was a little shocked."
paragraphs.cn: Cregger在播客中进一步说道：「我为这部电影感到自豪。我真的很喜欢它。我意识到，开始拍摄之前我本该更清楚情况，也应该明白事情会变成这样，但不知为何，我还是有点震惊。」

paragraphs.en: Did Cregger say he had ideas for a Resident Evil 2? Yes . Did he say he wanted to step away from franchise films after this one came out? Also yes . Now that the dust is starting to settle after fans spent months upset about his vision for the series, he has suggested he's not terribly interested in carrying the weight of an existing IP. Still, for him, it's a "never say never" situation.
paragraphs.cn: Cregger说过自己对《生化危机2》有想法吗？说过。他说过想在这部电影上映后暂时离开系列电影吗？也说过。粉丝们对他构想的系列方向不满了数月，如今风波开始平息，他表示自己对背负现有IP的重担并不太感兴趣。不过，对他来说，这件事仍然「不能把话说死」。

paragraphs.en: The conversation around Resident Evil may have given Cregger more than he bargained for, so we'll have to wait to see what happens next. In the meantime, he's tinkering away on his next original film, The Flood . A sci-fi thriller written, produced, and directed by Cregger, the movie will star Hunger Games veteran Jennifer Lawrence when it premieres August 11, 2028.
paragraphs.cn: 围绕《生化危机》的讨论或许超出了Cregger的预期，接下来会发生什么还得拭目以待。与此同时，他正在筹备下一部原创电影《The Flood》。这部科幻惊悚片由Cregger编剧、制片并执导，曾出演《饥饿游戏》的詹妮弗·劳伦斯将担任主演，影片将于2028年8月11日首映。

paragraphs.en: While we wait for updates, you can read about how the Resident Evil movie boosted sales for Capcom's game series . Be sure to also read up on how watchers reacted to the film's divisive ending .
paragraphs.cn: 在等待后续消息的同时，你可以了解《生化危机》电影如何带动卡普空旗下游戏系列的销量，也可以看看观众对影片颇具争议的结局作出了怎样的反应。
